scripts.prepare:web: mkdir -p www && cp -r ../../frontend/public/icon-192.png ../../frontend/public/icon-512.png www/ && echo '<!doctype html><meta http-equiv="refresh" content="0;url=https://www.zupidelivery.com.br/app?source=ios">' > www/index.html
scripts.ios:add: npm run prepare:web && npx cap add ios
scripts.ios:sync: npm run prepare:web && npx cap sync ios
